lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement posterior to the branchial region, consisting of four to five distinct vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontal carinae; circular blobs are primarily positioned within the resulting rectangular cells.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible; the uppermost ridge displays a strong vertical luminance gradient with a sharp light-to-shadow transition across the mid-flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: High-intensity blobs are visible across the dorsal fin silhouette, showing a higher density of smaller spots at the anterior base compared to the distal margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small white rectangular artifact or tag trailing from the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vermiculated/labyrinthine patterning of high-luminance lines located immediately posterior to the branchial region, transitioning into the standard blob grid.
